name: whatsapp
description: Send and receive WhatsApp messages with customers through the WhatsApp Business Platform (Meta Cloud API) via the myHub-hosted gateway. Send free-text replies inside the 24-hour window, send approved templates outside it, browse templates and business numbers, and mark messages read. Connected once by a tenant admin through Meta's sign-in.

connection.instructions: A tenant admin clicks Connect and signs in with Meta (Facebook) to link the business's WhatsApp Business number. No API keys are needed. Your own Meta account pays Meta's per-message fees.
